about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: The initial image literal for OUT-ACCT-REC is dead because 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD populates all fields of OUT-ACCT-REC before 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD writes the record.
The initial image literal for ARR-ARRAY-REC is dead because 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT executes INITIALIZE ARR-ARRAY-REC before populating and writing ARRYFILE.
The initial image literal for VBR-REC in the FD is dead because 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD and 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD populate the record buffer before each write.
The initial image literal for ACCOUNT-RECORD is dead because 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT executes READ ACCTFILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD which overwrites the record before use.
The initial image literal for CODATECN-REC is dead because 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD explicitly populates every subfield of CODATECN-REC before calling COBDATFT.
The initial image literal for ACCTFILE-STATUS is dead because 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN executes OPEN INPUT ACCTFILE which overwrites ACCTFILE-STATUS before any read.
The initial image literal for IO-STATUS is dead because IO-STATUS is only read in 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, which is always preceded by a MOVE to IO-STATUS.
The initial image literal for IO-STATUS-04 is dead because 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly overwrites all 4 characters of IO-STATUS-04 prior to displaying it.
The initial state arraycopy for ACCTFILE-STATUS is redundant because 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN issues OPEN INPUT ACCTFILE which sets ACCTFILE-STATUS before any read.
The initial arraycopy for IO-STATUS-04 is dead because 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS explicitly formats and moves all four status bytes into IO-STATUS-04 before DISPLAY.
f91_APPL_RESULT is unconditionally assigned 8L at the very start of 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN, so the zero assignment in initialState() is never read.
The performThru array expansion in perform() is guarded by mine >= performThru.length (initial capacity 64), but perform call depth in CBACT01C never exceeds 2.
In perform(), the loop condition d < 0 is never satisfied because d starts at mine - 1 and decrements towards 0.
In perform(), incrementing d++ in the reverse traversal loop never executes because the loop is never entered when i == thru.
In perform(), the loop condition d > 0 prevents checking index 0, but CBACT01C never calls PERFORM THRU across different paragraphs.
In perform(), starting the search loop at d = mine + 1 instead of mine - 1 reads out of active bounds, but the loop tail is never entered.
In perform(), inverting the condition performThru[d] == i has no effect because all perform calls in CBACT01C have start equal to thru.
In perform(), testing performThru[d] != i in the search loop is unreachable because CBACT01C performs are simple single-paragraph invocations.
In perform(), next > 17 is unreachable because paragraphs in CBACT01C are numbered from 0 to 16 only.
In perform(), next >= 17 is negated, but next never exceeds 16 because CBACT01C defines 17 paragraphs indexed 0 through 16.
In perform(), testing next < 17 in the paragraph bounds check is equivalent because next never exceeds 16 for valid paragraphs in CBACT01C.
Restoring performDepth in the finally block of perform() has no observable effect because performDepth is only used internally for stack frame tracking upon paragraph exit.

survivors.reason: In 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT, clearing VB1-ACCT-ID to zeros is dead because 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD unconditionally moves ACCT-ID into VB1-ACCT-ID prior to write.
Paragraph 15 is 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM which terminates unconditionally via CobolAbend.user, so paragraph 16 in the PERFORM 15 THRU 16 range can never be reached.
In 4000-VBRFILE-OPEN, f91_APPL_RESULT is initialized to 8L and setting it to 12L on open failure is never observed because control proceeds directly to 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
In 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, f91_APPL_RESULT is already set to 8L upon open failure; setting it to 12L is never read because 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM abends immediately.
In 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, adding zero versus subtracting zero from BigDecimal constant D8 produces identical numeric value.
In 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, subtracting t12 from f91_APPL_RESULT produces zero; formatting zero into 9 versus 10 binary digits yields the exact same byte representation.
In 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, adding zero versus subtracting zero from BigDecimal constant D12 is an arithmetic identity producing the identical numeric value.
